o1.biggest_mistake: It gives single-point targets (6,762 tickets, 28.7% bra return rate) instead of a range. It also skips a day-3 'still on track' nudge, the very days when 62% of tickets arrive.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Give low and high ranges for each saving, add a short day-3 update, and put real fit tips in the post-delivery bra email.

reason: Both plans find the same three problems and get the numbers right. Output 2 gives me honest ranges, a day-3 update that catches the ticket spike, and fit tips that could stop a return before it starts, which is what I hoped for.
